name: Accueil
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a new high-fidelity desktop CRM screen using the attached image ONLY as the approved visual design and navigation reference. This is a DIFFERENT screen of the same CRM, not an edit of its data and not a reproduction of the pipeline. Preserve the attached image's clean white and pale-gray palette, neutral borders, system sans typography, restrained shadcn-like controls, slim LEFT SIDEBAR, compact scale, spacing rhythm, plain header, quiet professionalism and Folk-inspired minimalism. Landscape 1920x1080, front-on flat full screen, no desktop hardware, browser chrome, poster or perspective. Sidebar logo "CRM"; EXACT destinations "Accueil", "Contacts", "Sociétés", "Pipeline", "Relances". Keep a small sidebar footer "Maquette · Données fictives". No fictitious content presented as real user data. No calendar, AI, scoring, charts, KPI dashboard, marketing, integration, enrichment, avatar photos or extra navigation. Other than the sidebar, DO NOT carry over pipeline columns, the pipeline header, or the right detail panel: this screen uses the full main content width. Do not show "Enregistré" if nothing has just saved. Mockup text must be crisp French, accurate and legible. Use only the specific content and layout below. Any names, amounts, dates are synthetic demonstration data. Distinguish selected nav item with the same light-gray background as reference. Keep controls compact and modest; no giant heading or decorative cards.
SCREEN: ACCUEIL. Sidebar Accueil selected. Main page header "Accueil", small date "6 septembre 2026", subtitle "Vos priorités commerciales." Show one calm main section "À faire en priorité" and smaller helper "Jusqu’à 5 tâches". Display FOUR tasks only because four are available; do not invent a fifth. Compact readable horizontal rows in a single wide task list, not a card grid and not statistics. First two are due or overdue and ordered by closeness to signature; last two are upcoming fillers by date. Each row has task title, linked opportunity below or beside it, stage, and due date. Row 1: "Relancer le devis", opportunity "Accompagnement CRM", stage "Proposition envoyée", due "5 sept." with subdued red text "En retard". Row 2: "Préparer le devis", opportunity "Audit des processus", stage "Échange en cours", due "Aujourd’hui". Row 3: "Recontacter le prospect", opportunity "Formation équipe", stage "Échange en cours", due "8 sept.". Row 4: "Qualifier le besoin", opportunity "Atelier automatisation", stage "À qualifier", due "9 sept.". The task names and opportunity references are visually clear, no amount columns, no checkbox or done controls on this screen because the user approved quick completion only in Relances. A small arrow or link allows opening context. Beneath or at section header a clear secondary text link "Voir toutes les relances" connects to the complete task view. A quiet text cue "1 tâche en retard" can be placed near that link, based on this sample data. No empty fifth slot. Generous unused space below is fine, no invented widgets. Composition should make choosing the next action immediate.
approvalScope: Disposition de cet écran ; données fictives et imperfections de génération exclues ; pas validation globale des arbitrages résiduels
